test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is false?

options.text: All natural numbers together with zero are called integers.
There is no largest natural number.
There is no largest whole number.

solution:
Calculation:

1) All natural numbers together with zero are called integers.

2) There is no largest natural number.

3) There is no largest whole number.

4) 1 is the smallest natural number.

⇒ Statement 1 is false because integers also include negative numbers.

**⇒ Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.**
